name: Thomas Eubank
title: Software Engineer
about: Hi, I'm Thomas Eubank. Computers have been my passion for as long as I can remember, and I'm eager to build a career around them. My experience centers on two things I genuinely enjoy: optimizing performance-critical C++ systems and shipping full-stack web applications that real teams depend on. I'm actively looking for software engineering opportunities — and if you have a project that Eubank Technologies could take on, reach out. Let's build something.

entries.title: Founder & Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and deployed Stat_Line, a full-stack pitch analytics web application (Flask, PostgreSQL, Docker, Railway) serving NCAA baseball programs, built on client-originated requirements from Morehead State University.
Developed automated PDF report generation and Trackman CSV data processing pipelines, delivering per-pitcher performance breakdowns with custom school branding.
Engineered a multi-tenant subscription system (Stripe) supporting account creation and role-based access.
Actively demoing to prospective university clients; managing full product lifecycle from requirements through deployment.
Utilized Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to maintain development velocity across a solo full-stack codebase.

entries.title: Software Engineer Intern (.NET/C#)
bullets: Migrated and deployed 100+ C# applications to a new server environment; modernized legacy programs to .NET 4.7.2+; leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate refactoring throughput.
Developed and published a reusable NuGet email package (Azure Communication Services) standardizing email functionality across hundreds of enterprise applications, reducing maintenance overhead.

entries.title: IT Support Technician
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved 10-25+ daily tickets spanning hardware, networking, and identity/access management across a diverse, non-technical user base; supported frontline triage after a university-wide cybersecurity incident.
Onboarded and technically mentored incoming helpdesk staff.

entries.title: IT Support Technician
bullets: Delivered and deployed computers, peripheral devices, and networking equipment across multiple school locations.
Cooperated with teachers, staff, and coworkers to resolve technical issues and provide support.
Installed and configured software applications on student and faculty computers.

entries.title: Parallel Matrix Library & Neural Network
entries.description: 17× speedup on 1000×1000 matrix multiplication using Intel SYCL USM. Modular C++ neural network with Adam optimizer and cross-entropy loss, outperforming PyTorch CPU on the UCI thyroid dataset with 40% training time reduction.

entries.title: Stat_Line
entries.description: Full-stack web app for Morehead State Baseball providing advanced TrackMan statistics, visualizations, and PDF reports. Marketed to other colleges.

entries.title: Email Integration NuGet Package
entries.description: Integrated and standardized email functionality across hundreds of enterprise C# applications via a custom NuGet package using the Azure API.

entries.title: Eagle Recruitment
entries.description: Served as technical lead for an 8-person team building a recruitment web app for the Women's Basketball Team. Pulls from the NJCAA database with an ML model in development for dynamic data interpretation.

entries.title: Savecation
entries.description: Organized a 4-person team to build a travel-budgeting web app applying full Software Engineering principles.

entries.title: Calculator Language Parser
entries.description: Lightweight programming language scanner and parser in under 600 lines of C++ with tokenization, syntax analysis, and error codes.

entries.title: VEX Robotics 2018
entries.description: Reached the World Championship in the VEX Robotics competition. Assisted in the design and implementation of control software for the robotic system. Gained experience in teamwork, problem-solving, and applying engineering principles in a competitive environment.

entries.title: MSU ACM Vice President
bullets: Supervised a team of 15 students in organizing events and managing the chapter's operations.
Managed meetings, supported chapter initiatives, improved Morehead community involvement of ACM members.
Created opportunities for professional development and networking among chapter members.

entries.title: Outstanding CS Student
entries.description: Recognized by the Morehead State University chapter of the Association for Computing Machinery as the outstanding Computer Science student of the graduating class.

entries.title: World Championship Qualifier
entries.description: Qualified for and competed at the VEX Robotics World Championship, contributing to robot design and C based control software under competitive pressure.

entries.title: Dean's List
entries.description: Earned Dean's List recognition across multiple semesters for maintaining a GPA above 3.5.

entries.title: President's List
entries.description: Achieved President's List standing in recent semesters, recognizing a 4.0 semester GPA.

entries.title: Commonwealth Scholarship
entries.description: Merit-based scholarship awarded upon enrollment in recognition of high school academic achievement — GPA and ACT score.

entries.title: Computer Science Department Award
entries.description: Awarded for outstanding performance in the Computer Science department's classes by helping students and taking on leadership roles.
